name: sdlc
description: Whoever made a change, someone else attacks it, and a machine decides when it is done: a build skill that agrees with you what to build and why as testable Given/When/Then criteria, for a feature, a bug or a refactor, plans it and has the plan reviewed, writes failing tests first, and has fresh agents implement, review and verify, and a spike skill for throwaway experiments; plus hooks for a done check, an AGENTS.md size cap, a dependency gate, a pull request size cap, and gates on commits that leave in debugging leftovers or switch a checker off. At session start, a hook adds house rules for how the agent works with you, and a delegator agent runs non-coding tasks in parallel.
